reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it is presented as a Bangla tutorial or walkthrough for a mobile earning app, showing payment-message examples, an app-store listing, account creation, tasks, and a spin-wheel interface. The title and description include spin-to-earn and Bkash payment claims, an app link, and a referral code, but the described material does not establish a false payment outcome, impersonation, credential misuse, or independently verified harmful money flow. The earning claims and request for account information are risk-relevant cues, but they remain within the described app-demonstration context.

opening.argument: Judge the promise together with the path offered to viewers. The title connects spins to specific Bkash payments, while the description supplies both an app link and a referral code. The walkthrough then shows account creation and a spin interface. That sequence makes the payment claim more than a passing topic: it gives viewers a way to sign up and try to obtain the advertised cash. The evidence does not verify that a spin produces a withdrawable payment, so the promise-action pairing is the decisive concern.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The tutorial framing does not separate the lesson from the solicitation. The cited app link and referral code provide the route to participate, and the account screen shows what participation entails. Nor does the absence of a verified false payout resolve the concern: the title presents specific cash results, while the defense identifies no evidence that those results are reliably withdrawable. A demonstration can still recruit viewers through an unsubstantiated reward claim.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The title makes an earning claim, and the description offers an app link, but their pairing does not establish that the claim is false or that signing up causes a loss. The account and spin screens are also consistent with a walkthrough of how the app operates. The prosecution has identified a reason to scrutinize the claim, not evidence of a deceptive payout or harmful outcome.

citations.quote: 1 Spin :play button:৳100 :check mark button: 10 Spin ৳1000 Bkash Payment

opening.argument: Several signals reinforce one another here. The description uses “Payment 100%” alongside a daily income figure; the video shows received-cash messages; and the app listing visibly includes a review warning that payment will not arrive. A judge need not treat either the messages or the review as independently verified outcomes. The concern is how confident payment language and apparent payout examples can encourage trust despite an on-screen warning about withdrawal. That combination makes the easy-cash pitch suspect, not merely the subject of a neutral app tutorial.

citations.quote: How to earn money per day 1000 TK Payment 100%

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense is right that payment messages do not independently prove payouts. But that cuts against relying on them as reassurance while the description says “Payment 100%.” Its walkthrough characterization also leaves out the visible negative payment review. The review is not conclusive proof of nonpayment; it is a directly relevant counterweight to the certainty of the promotional wording.

citations.quote: How to earn money per day 1000 TK Payment 100%

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The negative review is a visible user allegation, not verification that this video's payment claim is false. Likewise, the received-cash messages do not establish that viewers will be paid, but showing them does not establish fabrication. The description's confident earning language warrants skepticism; these sources still do not resolve actual payout conditions or demonstrate a deceptive transaction.

citations.quote: How to earn money per day 1000 TK Payment 100%

opening.argument: The tutorial format is part of this video's persuasive force. The description calls it a Bangla tutorial, but also gives viewers an app link and referral code. The shown account-creation, news-task and spin screens turn an earning claim into a sequence viewers can follow. The title supplies the intended payoff: stated Bkash amounts for spins. Calling that sequence instruction does not erase its promotional function. The judge should weigh the walkthrough as a participation funnel built around a cash promise whose payout is not established by the demonstration.

citations.quote: Every day 500 tk in bangla tutorial 2021

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense describes the same sequence as an operational demonstration, but instruction and promotion can coexist. Here, a referral code sits beside the app link, while the title frames the activity in terms of Bkash earnings. The walkthrough therefore matters not just for what the interface looks like, but for how it helps a viewer act on that claim. The defense's lack-of-proof point limits certainty about outcomes; it does not make the invitation incidental.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The app link and referral code support a promotional reading, but promotion alone does not establish a scam. The account, task and spin screens substantiate that the video walks through an app rather than merely issuing an unsupported command to send money. The prosecution's framing does not show that the stated Bkash earnings are false, that the app misuses account information, or that viewers suffer a harmful payment outcome.
